scopeChangeReason: W2d envelope validation plus one read-only command; the command needs the same registration recipe W2b and W2c used, including packages/main/src/registry.ts and core/lifecycle-registry.ts.

acknowledgements.reason: activity-policy.ts is where the story's central read-only claim becomes mechanically enforced: adding red_evidence_envelope_check to READ_ONLY_COMMANDS is what guarantees at the CLI choke point that the pre-flight appends no hook, no activity log and no process event. CHK-012 asserts exactly that property, so this edit is squarely in scope; it was simply missed from the allowedModify list when the contract was authored.

Lifecycle-required write with a diagnosed mechanical cause, not a chosen expansion. story_advance --phase=DONE refuses with missing_dev_memory_finish_decision until dev_memory_finish_decision is recorded, and recording 'captured' honestly required first capturing this story's three reusable lessons via dev_memory_capture, which appends to this one designed cross-agent ledger. THE MECHANISM, traced by the delivery reviewer rather than argued by me: packages/main/src/core/runtime-artifact-registry.ts carries an explicit dev-memory-finish-decision entry (prefix .lattice/dev-memory/finish-decisions/, materialHash 'exclude') - which is why the finish-decision file passed silently - and NO equivalent entry for its sibling .lattice/dev-memory/experience.jsonl, so the unknown path fails closed as OUT_OF_SCOPE. That registry entry's own comment records the identical problem being hit and fixed once already for the sibling path, noting it 'broke delivery-check materialHash freshness'. This is therefore a registry gap that every story capturing a lesson will hit, not evidence this story overran its contract, and it is filed as B-def6 with the reproduction and both candidate fixes. Worth recording plainly: the cheapest route past this gate today is --decision=no-reusable-lesson, which clears it by declining to record what the story learned, so the dishonest path is currently the cheap one. No story-owned source file changed; git diff main HEAD outside .lattice remains this story's own 18 files.
